section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the relationship between body appreciation and body image flexibility as two complementary measures of positive body image among ethnic-minority young women. The authors note a strong positive relationship between these constructs (sharing approximately 49% of variance), suggesting meaningful conceptual overlap while maintaining distinct characteristics. Body appreciation is presented as a more holistic measure of positive body image, while body image flexibility is described as a more contextual, experiential approach that may provide the regulatory skills to facilitate body appreciation behaviors.
